Results.ReviewText: I really like it, as I do all the Weber grills I own which include an older performer and Smokey Joe . The heat is very consistent and easy to control and manipulated with different zones of heat. Lights easily with push of the button. Only thing I don’t like is back of the stand had no rear plate to enclose the propane tank and drip pan to keep debris from wind and outdoor element and which would also add more strength to base and why I am giving this grill only 4 stars
Results.Title: I really like it

Results.ReviewText: Great grill.  Just wish brackets could be included to allow the tables to fold down as an option. (Brackets are available on other models).
Results.Title: Want brackets included to allow fold down tables.

Results.ReviewText: The  Spirit E310 gas grill is very nice looking easy to move with solid wheels warms up quickly and does a great job of barbecuing food. The only negative I have is that it was very difficult understanding how to put the propane bottle in and in hooking it on the little hook. I had to watch a video on YouTube in order to understand what to do I am 75 years old was unable to lift the propane bottle my neighbor had to do it for us.  Other than that the barbecue is great and I highly recommend it
Results.Title: Spirit E310 gas barbecue

Results.ReviewText: I have been a Weber grill customer for over twenty years. I use my current grill almost daily. Consequently, the flavorizor bars rusted out after just two years. When I called to purchase new bars, Lena, the Weber representative said my grill was still under warranty, even though I never registered it with Weber since it was a gift.  Lena registered the grill after the fact, and ordered replacement bars, which arrived a week later to a very happy customer!
Results.Title: Great Customer Service

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback is important to us. Our Care Team will follow up to make sure this has been resolved. Please look for an outreach from us soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: Never received my replacement parts and tracking has been canceled.
Results.Title: Replacement part fail

Results.ReviewText: great grill but absolutely terrible to assemble.  very poor instructions
Results.Title: aaaa

Results.ReviewText: We bought a Weber grill about 6 years ago at the recommendation of my boss. He said his is 25 years old and still going strong. We have never had an issue with ours and we have one in New Jersey and one in Florida. Everything cooks even with the grill.
Results.Title: Weber “the best grill”

Results.ReviewText: This is good looking grill. I appreciate the large cooking space and 3 burners. The ability to cook with direct and indirect heat is terrific. The fuel guage is very helpful.
Results.Title: An excellent grill

Results.ReviewText: Great product and easy to use. Temperatures easily controlled.
Results.Title: Grill All Year Long

Results.ReviewText: Recent purchase.  So far so good. I had a Weber Genesis for >30 years - I suspect I’ll miss the auxiliary burner to some degree. Solid brand.
Results.Title: Spirit E-310 recent purchase

Results.ReviewText: My 2nd Spirit E-310, first one lasted over 10 years.
Results.Title: Great grill, heats up fast, cooks evenly.

Results.ReviewText: I have only used the grill twice now and like it with one exception.  This is probably a design problem.  The grill has this scale that weighs the amount of propane in the tank.  My husband and I are in the 80's and do not have the strength to lift the propane tank on the scale.  IT sits on the ground and now the grill cannot be moved.  Bad engineering.
Results.Title: The propane weight scale is useless.

Results.ReviewText: Operationally it is great. Construction materials have been downgraded from my 8 yr old Weber.
Results.Title: Good but not great construction

Results.ReviewText: The Weber E-310 is my 3rd Weber.   I've never had a maintenance issue with my grill from Weber.   Each of my first 2 sold with properties rather than moving them.  My last grill worked in Boulder, CO and Louisville, CO for over 20 years with ZERO maintenance - just regular cleaning.    This product is smaller than my former Webers, but I'm retired - no family.
Results.Title: Weber's Perform FOREVER!!!

Results.ReviewText: I was disappointed when the grill arrived with the wrong back panel. Two calls to customer service. The first person said the correct panel would be delivered in 7-10 days. When it didn’t arrive, called again. This time was told the panel was out of stock and would not be available until after Nov 13-a month later, and to call back then to check on it. Not the quality of service I expect from Weber.
Results.Title: Shipped with wrong panel, out of stock at Weber

Results.ReviewText: Excellent Product and superb BBQ. Will recommend to anyone
Results.Title: Super nice product. easy to use and affordable

Results.ReviewText: Great grill with very well thought out features. I really like the propane fill gauge, the grease capture system.
Results.Title: Great grill I would buy again

Results.ReviewText: Not the same grill we bought 20 plus years ago definitely different quality
Results.Title: Mister

Results.ReviewText: The grill seems to be well built, provides excellent heat and is easy to clean.  I appreciate the well thought out feature, such as the electric ignition, the tank level indicator and grease catcher.  Sturdy construction should give me years of grilling pleasure.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: This is my first Weber purchase!  Love the way the food cooks!!
Results.Title: Love my Weber!

Results.ReviewText: has never let me down alway ready to ligth, best grill i ever owned. an a very supported by the manufacture with lot's of extract that really enhance the grill experiance and make it enjoyable to experiment with grilling.
Results.Title: great grill

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Weber grill. Great design. Cooks food wonderfully. Quality materials. I expect our new grill will last as long as our first which was for many, many years. Only surprise was inside the doors in the area where the propane tank sits. In my old grill the cutout for the tank was perfect. It allowed me to easily move the grill around on my deck. In my new grill, the cutout is too big and the tank sits on the deck (because the hole is too big). I cannot move the grill around which is a big disappointment. Still happy. The new grill is almost perfect!
Results.Title: Almost Perfect

Results.ReviewText: Purchased this Grill approximately 5 weeks ago. Works great, love the way it cooks.
Results.Title: Satisfied with new Gril

Results.ReviewText: Weber is top of the line grill y’all have been designing grills to perfection
Results.Title: Top notch

Results.ReviewText: Our family have owned Weber grills for decades.  The one just recently purchased works great.  The one very poor design is inside the cabinet.  Previous generation models had a design where a ring is fabricated such that the 20lb tank will sit, preventing the tank being on the patio/deck.  The new design has no such ring.  For those customers who move the grill, this becomes a real hassle.  My personal plan is to build some type of structure inside the cabinet that keeps the tank off the ground.  If I had realized of this poor design, other grill makes/models would have been given a more serious look.
Results.Title: Cabinet design

Results.ReviewText: Well built and moderately easy to put together, no surprises  it cools evenly
Results.Title: Another 25+ years

Results.ReviewText: When shipped you forgot by A screws. I had parts laying around my house for three days until you shipped them to me.  It the grill has been nice.
Results.Title: Missing parts. Go buy one already put together

Results.ReviewText: In true Weber fashion, this is a well constructed grill. Heat distribution is excellent. Unlike stamped steel grills, this is made to last. For a couple of hundred dollars more, you get a grill with a 10 year warranty.
Results.Title: Buy this grill

Results.ReviewText: In was looking rod a grill that displaces the heat evenly throughout the cooking surface.  And this grill does.  It is well constructed and woks great. Worth the investment.
Results.Title: Love IT

Results.ReviewText: Easy enough to build, and cooks like a dream. Chicken, steak and burgers have come off perfect. Companion app has helpful tips and guidelines for a less seasoned griller like myself.
Results.Title: Fantastic Barbecue

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
